verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs explicitly state you can pay both employees and contractors globally from one system ('Pay employees and contractors around the world in a single system' and 'Pay your employees and contractors around the world without waiting on transfers or conversion'), with unified payroll, tax filing, and reporting. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically of mixed W-2/1099 payroll runs, and detail on 1099 tax form handling (1099-NEC filing specifics).
